slot.base: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated 2D game sprite, square canvas, genuine transparent RGBA background. Bright friendly medieval fantasy tower-defense art. Rounded silhouette, large clean painted color regions, only 2-3 cel-shaded values, crisp dark brown #3a291e outlines equivalent to 5 pixels on a 192x192 canvas. Orthographic high three-quarter view, front face slightly visible, upper-left light. No text, glyphs, runes, ornaments, jewels, glow, grid, watermark, checkerboard, background scenery or external cast shadow. All measurements below refer to a logical 192x192 canvas; scale proportionally if rendering higher resolution. Keep exact composition and padding. Subject: an EMPTY LOW WIDE rounded-square flat stone building pad for a tower. Neutral warm-light gray stone compatible with gray medieval castle masonry, visibly brighter than green grass. Top surface is a large simple flat rounded rectangle with horizontal edges, NOT a diamond, not a circle, not a rock mound or upright stele. Top surface from x=16 to176 and y=44 to164, broad unbroken empty center. Front vertical thickness only from y=164 to178, darker gray, a thin modest bevel. Essential: coordinate (96,157) must be on the bright horizontal top surface, safely above its front boundary. The front edge at x96 must remain y164 or below. Main outline extent x14..178, y42..180. Extremely sparse small stone chips only at corners and a tiny touch of moss at side edges. No center cracks, no symbols, no brick subdivision, no raised rim. The slab is ready for a tower to be placed on it.
